approval: User: Also lock in this motion system. I think this is exactly what we want.

accepted: One persistent procedural full-body slime; no asset/emoji flash swaps.
Spring-driven lean, volume-compensating squash, ripple and local poke dent.
Continuous velocities: new impulses add to existing movement and then settle.
Idle breathing, blink/gaze timing and smooth face-weight retargeting.
Poke/shake response magnitudes and reduced-motion behavior.
excluded: Material, color, reflections, inner light and glow remain subject to design iteration.
Facial art and the proposed 42-mood graph are not newly approved by this motion approval.
The poke-to-next-face cycle is an audition convenience, not the production mood policy.
Task-specific choreography, props, voice and sound integration are future work.
No ESP32 performance, streaming, firmware or production harness integration is validated.
scope.publication: Local design lock only. No push, pull request or merge without new explicit consent.

physics.state: Each mode stores displacement x and velocity v. Do not reset them on a face/material/activity change.
physics.integrator: Semi-implicit Euler with substeps no larger than 1/240 s.
physics.faceWeightBlend: 1 - exp(-dt * rate); rate=14, or 35 for reduced motion. Controls blend on the same actor.

continuityRules: Preserve the same actor, base mesh and current spring state across expression changes.
Drive all channels from one monotonic animation clock; pause/hidden views do not advance it.
Retarget controls rather than generating intermediate frames or replacing the body.
Clear materials may change independently of these accepted motion blocks.
Future task gestures must compose with this base or use an explicitly reviewed new motion revision.
portingGuidance: Hashes protect this exact JavaScript/WebGL reference. A different renderer or language may port the behavior, but must verify equivalent movement separately; the hash check is not proof of device or physical performance.
